title_zh: 2.4GS/s 7.5MHz-BW 95.4dB-DR CT 4× 时间交错二阶 DSM 可实现具有高 ELD 容差的 0dBFS-MSA

authors: Yuekai Liu；Ziqiang Cai；Jingying Zhang；Yichen Jin；Zhenzhen Tian；Guoxing Wang；Liang Qi

abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种连续时间 (CT)、四通道 ($4{\times)}$时间交错 (TI) delta-sigma 调制器 (DSM)。基于 CT 二阶前馈环路滤波器 (LF)，通过使用数字外推法构建了等效的 $4{\times }$TI CT DSM。因此，整个 $4{\times }$TI DSM 系统只需要两个有源积分器和三个量化器 (QTZ)。请注意，$4{\times }$TI 实现允许 DSM 模拟环路采用较低的采样率。此外，利用数字外推法，模拟环路设计为仅作为一阶系统运行，而完整的二阶噪声传递函数 (NTF) 在数字后端合成。值得注意的是，一阶模拟环路表现出很强的......
abstract_en: This article presents a continuous-time (CT), four-channel ($4{\times)}$time-interleaved (TI) delta–sigma modulator (DSM). Based on a CT 2nd-order feedforward loop filter (LF), an equivalent$4{\times }$TI CT DSM has been constructed by using digital extrapolation. Thereby, it merely requires two active integrators and three quantizers (QTZs) for the overall$4{\times }$TI DSM system. Note that the$4{\times }$TI implementation allows a lower sampling rate for the DSM analog loop. Furthermore, leveraging digital extrapolation, the analog loop is designed to operate solely as a 1st-order system, whereas the complete 2nd-order noise transfer function (NTF) is synthesized in the digital backend. Notably, the 1st-order analog loop exhibits strong robustness to excess loop delay (ELD)—an inherent issue in CT implementations. Consequently, the$4{\times }$TI CT DSM maintains high immunity to ELD without requiring any compensation, thereby greatly simplifying the overall$4{\times }$TI system. Fabricated in a 65-nm CMOS process and clocked at 600 MHz, the prototype yields an equivalent sampling rate of 2.4 GS/s. With the on-chip DAC calibration enabled, it achieves a dynamic range (DR) of 95.4dB and a signal-to-noise and distortion ratio (SNDR) of 87.5 dB over a 7.5-MHz bandwidth (BW) with a full-scale, 2.2-MHz input signal. Consuming 21.92 mW of power at 1.2/1.8-V supplies, it leads to a state-of-the-art FoM${}_{\mathrm {S\vert DR}}$of 180.7 dB.

abstract_zh: 无创血糖监测长期以来一直是糖尿病管理的重要研究热点。在新兴技术中，光声传感将分子特异性与深度渗透相结合，引起了人们的广泛关注。它提供快速响应和无痛操作，使其成为下一代便携式血糖监测设备的有力候选者。本综述系统地追踪了光声葡萄糖传感的发展和现状，特别关注核心系统组件的选择和优化。它还总结了葡萄糖检测中的常见干扰，并概述了缓解这些干扰的策略，以及信号处理和信噪比增强......
abstract_en: Noninvasive blood glucose monitoring has long been a critical research focus in diabetes management. Among emerging technologies, photoacoustic sensing, combining the molecular specificity with deep penetration, has garnered significant attention. It offers rapid response and pain-free operation, making it a strong candidate for next-generation portable blood glucose monitoring devices. This review systematically traces the development and current state of photoacoustic glucose sensing, with a particular focus on the selection and optimization of core system components. It also summarizes common interference in glucose detection and outlines strategies for their mitigation, along with signal processing and signal-to-noise ratio enhancement techniques suitable for real-world applications. Addressing the growing demand for wearable continuous glucose monitors, this work analyzes the key challenges in system integration and outlines recent advances in enabling technologies. It proposes multi-technology integration approaches to bridge the gap between photoacoustic sensing and microsystem design, offering theoretical foundations and practical guidance for future research on wearable photoacoustic systems.

authors: Yang Lin；Pujia Xing；Huaiyu Liu；Guoxing Wang；Yan Liu

abstract_zh: 基于电容耦合 (CC) 压控振荡器 (VCO) 的连续时间调制器 (CTDSM) 将宽共模输入范围和高线性度与固有的噪声整形和直接数字输出相结合，使其对生物电势记录具有吸引力。虽然斩波对于抑制闪烁噪声和提高共模抑制比 (CMRR) 至关重要，但它会严重降低输入阻抗，削弱微弱的生物信号。应用正反馈或降低斩波频率可以减轻这种退化，但是，前者的补偿精度有限，后者由于输入参考偏移电压$V_{os,in}$而引入带内纹波和其他非理想性。为了克服这些...
abstract_en: The capacitively coupled (CC) voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO)-based continuous-time$\rm \Delta \Sigma $modulator (CTDSM) combines a wide common-mode input range and high linearity with inherent noise-shaping and direct digital output, making it attractive for biopotential recording. While chopping is essential to suppress flicker noise and improve the common-mode rejection ratio (CMRR), it severely degrades input impedance, attenuating weak biosignals. Applying positive feedback or lowering chopping frequency can alleviate this degradation, however, the former suffers from limited compensation precision and the latter introduces in-band ripple and other nonidealities due to the input-referred offset voltage$V_{os,in}$. To overcome these issues, this paper presents a digitally-enhanced CC VCO-based CTDSM: first, a current-injection phase-locked loop (PLL)-based pulse-width-modulation (PWM) generator for precise positive feedback capacitance tuning to boost input impedance; second, a mostly digital ripple reduction loop (RRL) that suppresses$V_{os,in}$via a configurable digital integrator and a current-steering digital-to analog converter (IDAC). Fabricated in 180-nm CMOS, the prototype achieves an input impedance of 12.97 G$\Omega $at 2 Hz with a 10 kHz chopping frequency, while simultaneously achieving an input-referred noise (IRN) of$2.75~\mu V_{rms}$, a peak signal-to-noise and distortion ratio (SNDR) of 82.9 dB over a 1 kHz bandwidth, and a 160 mVpp input range that accommodates typical electrode DC offset variations, all within an area of 0.085 mm2and a power consumption of$10.06~\mu $W.

title_en: A 3.64 μ J/Frame Visual-Aided Speech Enhancement Processor for −10 dB Noise Tolerance
authors: Nan Wu；Siqi Wang；Huizheng Wang；Peng Wang；Xiao Liu；Zhihua Wang；Yang Hu；Guoxing Wang；Yanshu Guo；Hanjun Jiang

abstract_zh: 在极其嘈杂的环境中，视觉辅助语音增强 (VASE) 比纯音频模型表现出更强大的性能。然而，多模态融合独特的计算特性导致硬件效率显着降低。在本文中，我们提出了一款专为智能助听器量身定制的节能 VASE 处理器，以实现高噪声容忍度。为了解决功率预算有限的多模态处理的具体挑战，提出了三种关键的软件-硬件协同优化技术。首先，提出了冗余推测动态计算（RSDC）架构。使用迁移学习，它可以从高级语音特征中获取动态信号。基于这个级别，RSDC动态调整...
abstract_en: Visual-aided speech enhancement (VASE) exhibits robust performance over the audio-only models in extremely noisy environments. However, the distinct computational properties of multimodal fusion introduce significant hardware inefficiencies. In this article, we present an energy-efficient VASE processor tailored for intelligent hearing aids to achieve high-noise tolerance. To address the specific challenges of multimodal processing with a limited power budget, three key software–hardware co-optimization techniques are proposed. First, a redundancy speculation dynamic computing (RSDC) architecture is proposed. Using transfer learning, it derives a dynamic-level signal from high-level speech features. Based on this level, RSDC dynamically adjusts the computation flow to bypass unnecessary visual extraction and modality fusion, eliminating 36.9% of overall computations. Second, a multi-domain coding processing element (MCPE) employs three heterogeneous coding domains to adaptively match varying weight distributions, offering up to a$2.14\times $efficiency gain in multiplications. Third, a bipolar computing engine (BCE) is proposed to minimize dynamic power of accumulation. By predicting the accumulation sign using the sign bits of weights and activations, it enables a sign-aware scheduling of the accumulation order and improves processing efficiency by$2.51\times $. Fabricated in a 22 nm CMOS process, the processor consumes only$228~\mu $W of power at 0.65 V. The proposed design achieves an energy efficiency of$3.64~\mu $J/frame and a noise tolerance of −10 dB. This represents up to a$3.23\times $improvement in energy efficiency and a 7 dB extension of the evaluated noise-tolerance boundary.

title_zh: 具有低于 1V 跨阻放大器和基于 LC-ADC 的幅度控制环路的低相位误差 FD-fNIRS 读出电路
title_en: A Low-phase-error FD-fNIRS Readout Circuit with Sub-1V Transimpedance Amplifier and LC-ADC-based Amplitude Control Loop
authors: Cheng Chen；Zheng Ding；Guoxing Wang；Kang-Kang Xu；Mohamad Sawan；Nan Zeng；Shuo Zhang；Jian Zhao

abstract_zh: 频域功能近红外光谱（FD-fNIRS）利用光在组织中的传播时间和振幅衰减来量化血氧浓度。这使得能够更详细地监测人脑活动，为非侵入性和可穿戴脑机接口（BCI）设备提供潜在的解决方案。然而，相位检测器中比较器的幅相耦合效应引入了相位误差，进而导致光传播时间的测量不准确。为了抑制幅相耦合效应，采用了基于电平交叉模数转换器（LC ADC）的幅度控制环路。 LC ADC 的使用消除了对高sp...
abstract_en: Frequency-domain functional near-infrared spectroscopy (FD-fNIRS) ultilizes the propagation time and amplitude attenuation of light in tissue to quantify blood oxygen concentration. This enables more detailed monitoring of human brain activity, providing a potential solution for non-invasive and wearable brain-computer interface (BCI) devices. However, the amplitude-phase coupling effect of the comparator in the phase detector introduces phase errors, which in turn leads to inaccuracies in the measurement of light propagation time. To suppress amplitude-phase coupling effect, an amplitude control loop based on the level-crossing analog-to-digital converter (LC ADC) is employed. The utilization of the LC ADC eliminates the need for a high-speed envelope detector, thereby reducing circuit complexity and power consumption. In addition, a sub-1V transimpedance amplifier (TIA) is employed to improve energy efficiency. The proposed structure achieves a phase error of 0.11° and 12 mW power consumption.

abstract_zh: 本文演示了适用于片上实验室 (LOC) 应用的采用薄膜晶体管 (TFT) 技术的 64 通道多模式有源像素传感器 (APS) 阵列。该原型采用 3 微米低温多晶硅 (LTPS) 技术，集成了四种模式，包括电记录、化学记录、光学记录和电刺激，从而能够在单个玻璃基板上同时进行多模式信号记录和调节。 APS架构方案旨在解决低成本、大面积电子平台中的可扩展性和信号完整性的挑战。每个单位像素的面积为1130μm×1130μm，包括1个电记录位点、1个化学记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个光记录位点、1个电记录位点、1个光记录位点、1130μm×1130μm面积。
abstract_en: This article demonstrates a 64-channel multimodal active pixel sensor (APS) array in thin-film transistor (TFT) technology for lab-on-chip (LOC) applications. The prototype, implemented in a 3-μm low-temperature polysilicon (LTPS) technology, integrates four modalities, including electrical recording, chemical recording, optical recording, and electrical stimulation, enabling simultaneous multimodal signal recording and conditioning on a single glass substrate. The APS architecture scheme is designed to address the challenges of scalability and signal integrity in low-cost, large-area electronic platforms. Each unit pixel occupies an area of 1130 μm × 1130 μm, and includes one electrical recording site, one chemical recording site, one optical recording site, and one electrical stimulation site. The recording electrodes and the chemical sensing membrane are directly formed through a standard LTPS process. The in-pixel amplifier directly pre-amplifies the readout signal, while the ion-sensitive thin-film transistor (ISTFT) and N-type photo TFT are employed for chemical and optical sensing, respectively. Measurement results in saline solution demonstrate that the array can stably record signals from all modalities. The on-chip electrical recording achieves an amplification gain of 45.28 dB, the chemical recording achieves a sensitivity of 23.4 mV/pH, and the optical recording achieves a responsivity of 0.6 nA/W at 685 nm when biased in the subthreshold region. This work demonstrates that active pixel array in the TFT process with the proposed circuits and architecture can realize large-scale, low-cost, and flexible lab-on-chip tools for multimodal biological cell assays and surface-adherent biosensing applications.

title_en: Automated Pediatric Delirium Recognition via Deep Learning-Powered Video Analysis
authors: Cheng Chen；Xiaoyu Lin；Lixiang Gu；Yali Huang；Guoxing Wang；Wenyi Luo；Jiarong Chen；Liebin Zhao；Wenqi Shi；Yemin Gong；Haibao Chen；Suqin Xia

abstract_zh: 谵妄是一种急性的、波动性的意识障碍状态，其特征是认知改变和知觉障碍。儿童谵妄的发生率明显高于成人谵妄，临床医生分析耗时耗力，需要有效的识别方法。深度学习已显示出提取稳健表征和改善患者治疗结果的潜力。本研究从多家医院采集了129个由专业临床医生标记的视频样本，其中74个非谵妄标记样本和55个谵妄标记样本。采用18层深度时空卷积神经网络，其中二维和一维卷积滤波器...
abstract_en: Delirium is an acute, fluctuating state of consciousness disturbance characterized by cognitive alterations and perceptual disturbances. Pediatric delirium has a notably higher incidence rate than adult delirium, and it is time-consuming and labor-intensive for clinicians to analyze, requiring effective recognition approaches. Deep learning has shown potential for the extraction of robust representations and improvement of patient outcomes. In this study, 129 video samples labeled by professional clinicians were collected from multiple hospitals, including 74 non-delirium and 55 delirium labeled samples. An 18-layer deep spatiotemporal convolutional neural network is employed, in which two-dimensional and one-dimensional convolutional filters are applied to individual video frames to extract frame-level and inter-frame-level features, respectively. The entire architecture is pretrained on a large-scale video analysis dataset, and a three-layer fully connected classification head is integrated for the delirium recognition task. The proposed model was fine-tuned with a training dataset and evaluated on a testing dataset, exploring various models and strategies. The proposed algorithm demonstrated robust classification performance, achieving an accuracy of 0.8718, precision of 0.8711, recall of 0.8730, and F1-score of 0.8715, with approximately 31.54 million model parameters. These metric results validate the clinical applicability and technical reliability of the model under various training and testing strategies. In addition, the developed delirium classification model is deployed a hospital system to enable intelligent video diagnosis. The independent test accuracy for 100 newly collected samples is 0.8800. Therefore, the proposed algorithm enables new methods for pediatric delirium recognition and cures.

abstract_en: This live demonstration shows a dual-modal neural sensing array system with back-end neural signal processing. The implemented system includes a front-end 32×32 pixels LabOn-Chip array and a back-end python-based data sorting and processing engine to examine. Within the array, a dual mode recordings pixels is capable to capture both electrical recording channel and three chemical recording channels, with integrated sensors/electrodes, amplifiers and digitization circuits. The spacing between active pixels is only 100μm. The 1024 electrical recording channels and 3072 chemical recording channels can simultaneously collect electrical and chemical signals for in-vitro brain slice at the sampling rates of 10kHz and 3.3kHz. The back-end data processing engine collect the data, analysis the correlation between recording sites.

title_en: A Single-Lead ECG Wearable Sensor With 1.04 s Latency for Cardiac and Biometric Detection Tasks
authors: Guoxing Wang；Yong Lian；Yuzhi Hao；Mingyi Chen；Yuxin Ji；Chao Wang；Yang Zhao；Jian Zhao；Yongfu Li

abstract_zh: 可穿戴心电图 (ECG) 传感器在心血管保健监测方面具有巨大潜力。然而，将心电图信号上传到服务器端设备进行诊断会带来隐私风险。多任务心电图处理器依赖于多心跳窗口和复杂模型，导致高延迟和能耗，限制了资源受限的可穿戴设备的部署。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种用于认证医疗保健的单导联心电图传感器，它执行 QRS 复合波检测（任务 1）、心律失常检测（任务 2）、生物识别（任务 3）和生物认证（任务 4）。该传感器在双模式单搏心电图段上使用不变频谱特征提取器来导出这些任务的归一化生物特征...
abstract_en: The wearable electrocardiogram (ECG) sensor has immense potential for cardiovascular healthcare monitoring. However, uploading ECG signals to server-side devices for diagnosis poses privacy risks. Multi-tasking ECG processors rely on multi-beat windows and complex models, leading to high latency and energy consumption that limit deployment in resource-constrained wearable devices. In this work, we present a single-lead ECG sensor for authenticated healthcare that performs QRS complex detection (Task 1), arrhythmia detection (Task 2), bio-identification (Task 3), and bio-authentication (Task 4). This sensor uses an invariant spectrum feature extractor on dual-mode single-beat ECG segments to derive normalized biometric features for these tasks, reducing the record latency to a single beat. A binary neural network (BNN) model is used for multi-task decision-making, achieving an accuracy of >94% across all tasks in the MIT-BIH database while reducing the model size to 5.725 kB. The sensor, implemented in 55-nm technology, occupies 0.50 mm2, with the digital processing core (DPC) occupying 0.27 mm2. Operating at a 0.85-V supply and 320-kHz clock, the DPC achieves a task latency of 1.04 s, representing a$2\times $–$12\times $reduction compared to state-of-the-art work, with inference energy of$0.19~\mu $J/task ($3.7\times $–$26\times $reduction).

abstract_zh: 传统的基于袖带的血压 (BP) 监测方法存在用户不适和间歇测量的固有局限性。相比之下，基于光电体积描记法（PPG）的血压估计提供了一种有前途的替代方案。然而，基于 PPG 的血压估计仍然存在一些关键挑战。首先，先前的证据表明，指戴式设备可以产生比腕戴式设备更高的可行性和质量的信号。其次，该领域尚未充分研究血压的长期变化。为了应对这些挑战，本研究开发了一种新颖的智能环平台并收集样本来训练和评估所提出的模型。包含来自 96 个主题的 116,995 个样本的大型数据集...
abstract_en: Traditional cuff-based blood pressure (BP) monitoring methods suffer from inherent limitations in user discomfort and intermittent measurement. In contrast, photoplethysmography (PPG)-based BP estimation provides a promising alternative. However, several critical challenges remain in PPG-based BP estimation. First, prior evidence indicates that finger-worn devices can yield signals with higher feasibility and quality than wrist-worn devices. Second, long-term variations in blood pressure have not been sufficiently investigated in this field. To address these challenges, this study develops a novel smart ring platform and collects samples to train and evaluate the proposed model. A large-scale dataset comprising 116,995 samples from 96 subjects is constructed to evaluate long-term performance. The trained model achieves mean absolute errors (MAE) of 11.20 mmHg for systolic blood pressure (SBP) and 7.51 mmHg for diastolic blood pressure (DBP). These results demonstrate that a smart ring provides a comfortable and practical solution for continuous blood pressure management in personalized healthcare.

authors: Jia‐Rong Chen；Rong Li；Bin Liu；Min Wang；Wenqi Shi；Ruize Gao；Qiu, Qingyan；Ronghua Tu；Wang, Yunpeng；Guoxing Wang；Min Dai；C J Chen

abstract_zh: 虽然连续心血管监测的势头不断增强，但当前的数字表型分析范式仍然从根本上受到单边传感和固定状态采集协议的限制。这些限制阻碍了生理动力学的全面表征，因为它们无法捕获臂间血流动力学不对称性和姿势依赖性变异性，而这些对于在现实世界场景中进行稳健的心血管评估至关重要。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 MAIBO，一种用于连续心血管监测的多姿势、不对称感知、智能双边观察数据集。 MAIBO 包含使用可穿戴环从双手采集的同步光电体积描记 (PPG) 信号，信号强度为 3...
abstract_en: While continuous cardiovascular monitoring has gained increasing momentum, current digital phenotyping paradigms remain fundamentally limited by unilateral sensing and fixed-state acquisition protocols. These constraints hinder a comprehensive characterization of physiological dynamics, as they fail to capture inter-arm hemodynamic asymmetry and posture-dependent variability that are critical for robust cardiovascular assessment across real-world scenarios. To address these limitations, we present MAIBO, a multi-posture, asymmetry-aware, intelligent bilateral observation dataset for continuous cardiovascular monitoring. MAIBO comprises synchronized photoplethysmography (PPG) signals acquired from both hands using wearable rings under three standardized postural conditions. The dataset includes 1810 participants and 7478 paired blood pressure recordings, with reference annotations of systolic blood pressure (SBP), diastolic blood pressure (DBP), heart rate (HR), and demographic attributes (Age, Gender, and BMI). All data were collected under controlled multi-postural protocols and subjected to stringent quality control procedures, including the removal of incomplete samples and missing signal segments.

title_en: A 12.5GHz 10-Phase Dual-Path Voltage-Controlled Ring Oscillator with 102% Frequency Tuning Range in 12nm FinFET
authors: Guoxing Wang；Hui Wang；Ziye Wang

abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种采用 12 nm FinFET 技术的 10 相双路压控环形振荡器 (VCRO)。与单路 VCRO 相比，额外的耦合路径可确保偶相输出并提高速度。此外，电流源晶体管的扩展余量同时增强了调谐范围和振荡频率。此外，还探索了结构优势和延迟单元的强度，以实现 12.5 GHz 的标称振荡频率和高达 102% 的宽频率调谐范围，并具有独特的偶数 10 相输出。还介绍了所提出的双路 VCRO 与常用的伪差分 VCRO 之间的比较，表明所提出的双路 VCRO 的频率提高了 28% 以上。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a 10-phase dual-path voltagecontrolled ring oscillator (VCRO) in 12 nm FinFET technology. The extra coupling paths ensure even-phase outputs with improved speed compared to the single-path VCRO. In addition, extended headroom of current source transistor enhances the tuning range and oscillation frequency simultaneously. Moreover, the structural advantage and delay cell's strength are explored to achieve a nominal oscillation frequency of 12.5 GHz and a wide frequency tuning range up to 102% with unique evennumbered 10-phase outputs. Comparison between the proposed dual-path VCRO and commonly-used pseudo-differential VCRO is also presented, demonstrating that the proposed dual-path VCRO attains an over 28% wider frequency tuning range with a higher maximum achievable oscillation frequency. Post-layout simulations show that the proposed VCRO covers 8.7 GHz to 16.6 GHz across PVT variations and exhibits robust performance with a phase noise of$\mathbf{- 7 6. 5 d B c}$at$\mathbf{1 M H z}$offset frequency when operating at 12.5 GHz under a 1 V supply voltage.

abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于基频脉冲注入的亚纳瓦级单电源晶体振荡器 (XO)。基于 ZVD 的集成自适应限幅器能够针对 162pW 的 PVT 变化实现精确的脉冲注入定时。基于离散 PWA 的幅度调节可实现振荡幅度调节，将驱动器功率降低至 93pW。 22nm 测试芯片在 425pW 和 $0.016\ \text{mm}^{2}$ 下显示出 3.7ppb Allan 偏差下限，工作温度范围为 $-40^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 至 125° C。
abstract_en: This paper presents a sub-nW, single-supply crystal oscillator (XO) based on pulse injection at fundamental frequency. The integrated ZVD-based adaptive slicer enables accurate pulse injection timing against PVT variations at 162pW. The discrete PWA-based amplitude regulation enables oscillation amplitude regulation, reducing driver power to 93pW. The 22nm test chip shows a 3.7ppb Allan deviation floor at 425pW and$0.016\ \text{mm}^{2}$, with an operating temperature range from$-40^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$to 125° C.

venue: IEEE Trans. Circuits Syst. II Express Briefs
authors: Xiaojun Guo；Jun Li；Hanbo Zhang；Guoxing Wang；Chen Lin；Leilai Shao；Yuqing Lou；Fakhrul Z. Rokhani；Yongfu Li；Jian Zhao
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 本简介提出了一种基于低温多晶硅 (LTPS) 薄膜晶体管 (TFT) 工艺的模数转换器 (ADC)。采用基于压控振荡器 (VCO) 的结构来承受过程不确定性。基于 VCO 的 ADC 的一个关键挑战是 VCO 的非线性问题。为了解决这个问题，本简报提出了一种具有电阻输入级的伪差分架构，可显着抑制二次和三次谐波，从而提高线性度。所提出的 ADC 采用 3-$\mu $m 量产 LTPS 工艺制造。它以 1 kS/s 的速度实现 10.23 位 ENOB，以 16 kS/s 的速度实现 8.22 位 ENOB。该简报的 FOMW 比 IGZO 技术中最先进的 ADC 好 24 美元\ 倍...
abstract_en: This brief proposes an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) based on a low-temperature polycrystalline silicon (LTPS) thin film transistor (TFT) process. A Voltage Controlled Oscillator (VCO)-based structure is employed to tolerate the process uncertainty. A key challenge in VCO-based ADCs is the non-linearity issue of the VCO. To address this, this brief presents a pseudo-differential architecture with resistive input stage, which significantly suppresses the 2nd and 3rd harmonics and thus improves the linearity. The proposed ADC is fabricated using a 3-$\mu $m mass-production LTPS process. It achieves a 10.23-bit ENOB at 1 kS/s and 8.22-bit ENOB at 16 kS/s. The FOMW of this brief is$24\times $better than the state-of-the-art ADCs in IGZO technology and$2\times $better than the best simulation result in LTPS technology. Under extreme PVT variations, proposed ADC can still maintain minor performance changes. We also demonstrate the successful acquisition and reconstruction of ECG signal.

title_en: A 6.4-GS/s, 200-MHz BW 77.3-dB DR 71.5-dB SNDR 2× TI Extrapolated CT DSM Employing Broadband Hybrid-Inputs Adder and Nonlinearity-Suppression DAC Encoder
authors: Yuekai Liu；Yichen Jin；Yan Liu；Mingqiang Guo；Sai‐Weng Sin；Zhichao Tan；Guoxing Wang；Liang Qi
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种宽带双通道 ($2{\times }$) 时间交织 (TI) 连续时间 (CT) Δ-Σ 调制器 (DSM)。$2{\times }$TI 技术将整个 DSM 环路的速度减半。前馈 (FF) 外推法仅使用一个完整的模拟 DSM 通道即可实现等效的 $2{\times }$TI 实现。此外，提出了宽带混合输入（即电阻器/$G_{m}$/IDAC/CDAC）电流模式加法器来实现求和级，这是 FF 外推和额外环路延迟（ELD）补偿所需的。为了加快加法器操作，通过应用电阻电容退化，加法器内部速度关键的 $G_{m}$ 输入路径的带宽 (BW) 至少扩展了 $4.6{\times }$。此外，考虑...
abstract_en: This article presents a wideband two-channel ($2{\times }$) time-interleaved (TI) continuous-time (CT) delta-sigma modulator (DSM).$2{\times }$TI technique halves the speed of the whole DSM loop. The feedforward (FF) extrapolation enables an equivalent$2{\times }$TI implementation using only one complete analog DSM channel. Moreover, a broadband hybrid-input (i.e., resistor/$G_{m}$/IDAC/CDAC) current-mode adder is proposed to implement the summing stage, which is required by the FF extrapolation and excess loop delay (ELD) compensation. To expedite the adder operation, the bandwidth (BW) of the speed-critical$G_{m}$-input paths inside the adder is extended by at least$4.6{\times }$by applying resistorcapacitor degenerations. Moreover, considering that the signal features of the output feedback from the two channels are similar, a preceding tri-level encoder is used for the outermost digital-to-analog converters (DACs), while both thermometer-type inputs are combined in opposite directions. It can significantly mitigate the linearity requirement of the outermost DACs. Sampled at 3.2 GHz, the 28-nm CMOS prototype achieves an equivalent sampling rate of 6.4 GHz [oversampling ratio (OSR)${=}16$]. It measures 77.3-dB DR, 71.5-dB SNDR, and 81.6-dB SFDR over 200-MHz BW while consuming 106-mW power. It results in state-of-the-art (SoTA) Schreier FoM${}_{S\vert \mathrm { SNDR}}$of 164.3 dB and FoM${}_{S\vert \mathrm { DR}}$of 170.1 dB. Note that it does not employ any explicit DAC linearization techniques.

title_zh: 基于 LTPS-TFT 的大面积 PPG 读出电路，具有改进的线性度和鲁棒性，适用于柔性医疗环
title_en: An LTPS-TFT-Based Large-Area PPG Readout Circuits With Improved Linearity and Robustness for Flexible Healthcare Ring
authors: Hanbo Zhang；Xiaojun Guo；Guoxing Wang；Zhouchen Ma；Yang Bo；Yuqing Lou；Liang Qi；Hao Wu；Jian Zhao；Yongfu Li
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 薄膜晶体管 (TFT) 可以在柔性基板上制造，为无缝、长期可穿戴健康监测提供了潜力。然而，有限的性能、工艺变化和运动伪影阻碍了柔性可穿戴设备的广泛采用。本文介绍了一种用于柔性医疗环的基于 TFT 的光电体积描记法 (PPG) 采集电路，集成了基于压控振荡器 (VCO) 的模拟前端 (AFE)，以克服 TFT 器件的低迁移率造成的性能限制。同时，提出了一种无死区（DZ-Free）鉴频鉴相器（PFD）并将其集成到VCO跨阻放大器（TIA）中以增强线性度。此外，还有一个 0-1 MASH VCO 模拟...
abstract_en: Thin-film transistor (TFT) can be fabricated on flexible substrates, offering potential for seamless, long-term wearable health monitoring. However, the limited performance, process variation, and motion artifacts hinder the widespread adoption of flexible wearable devices. This article presents a TFT-based photoplethysmography (PPG) acquisition circuit for flexible healthcare rings, integrating a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) based analog front-end (AFE) to overcome the performance limitations caused by the low mobility of TFT devices. Meanwhile, a dead-zone free (DZ-Free) phase-frequency detector (PFD) was proposed and integrated into the VCO transimpedance amplifier (TIA) to enhance the linearity. Additionally, a 0-1 MASH VCO-analog-to-digital conversion (ADC) structure was adopted to improve the quantization dynamic range (DR). The system is implemented using$\text {3-}$$\mu $m low-temperature poly-silicon (LTPS) TFT (LTPS-TFT) process of TIANMA Microelectronics. The measurement results show that DZ-Free PFD improves the linearity and the proposed VCO-TIA achieves a 61.5-dB DR. The proposed ADC demonstrates a 72-dB spurious-free dynamic range (SFDR), a 65.8-dB SNDR and an 80-dB DR. Under temperature sweeping from${-40}~{\mathrm {~^{\circ}C}}$to$80~{\mathrm {~^{\circ}C}}$and supply voltage variations of$10~{\pm }~2$V, the ADC maintains performance variations within 3%, while the TIA stably sustains a gain of 110 dB$\Omega $. Finally, PPG and blood oxygen saturation ($\text {SpO}_{{2}}$) measurements were demonstrated, including ambient light compensation. This work provides a feasibility demonstration for TFT-based fully integrated flexible electronics in bio-signal monitoring applications.

title_zh: 具有 15.4 MHz 带宽和 82.6 dB-SNDR 的流水线 MASH 连续时间 Delta-Sigma 调制器的分析和设计
title_en: Analysis and Design of a Pipelined MASH Continuous-Time Delta-Sigma Modulator With 15.4 MHz-BW and 82.6 dB-SNDR
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I Regular Papers
authors: Xinyu Qin；Yichen Jin；Mingqiang Guo；Guoxing Wang；Sai‐Weng Sin；Maurits Ortmanns；Yong Lian；Liang Qi
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了宽带流水线多级噪声整形 (MASH) 连续时间 (CT) Δ-Σ 调制器 (DSM) 的设计。整个$1^{\mathrm {st}}$级DSM的量化误差被提取为$2^{\mathrm {nd}}$级的输入，而两个级的输出则简单地组合，而不使用任何数字滤波器。总体而言，为两个 QN 生成不同的整形函数，而不需要任何数字 QN 消除。因此，流水线 MASH (PMASH) 显着减轻了 QN 泄漏，同时保留了传统 MASH 良好的环路稳定性。此外，还对 PMASH 拓扑进行了多项分析，例如设计指南、信号传递函数（STF）、鲁棒性等......
abstract_en: This paper presents the design of a wideband pipelined multi-stage noise shaping (MASH) continuous time (CT) delta-sigma modulator (DSM). The quantization error of the overall$1^{\mathrm {st}}$-stage DSM is extracted as the input of the$2^{\mathrm {nd}}$stage, while the outputs of both stages are simply combined without using any digital filters. Overall, different shaping functions are generated for both QN without requiring any digital QN cancellation. Therefore, the pipelined MASH (PMASH) significantly mitigates QN leakage while retaining the decent loop stability of a traditional MASH. Additionally, several analyses have been made for the PMASH topology, e.g. the design guideline, the signal transfer function (STF), the robustness, etc. Clocked at 800MHz and enabling on-chip DAC calibration, the 65nm CMOS prototype with an exemplary 2-2 topology using multi-bit quantizers achieves 82.6 dB SNDR, 98.8 dB SFDR over 15.4 MHz BW at −0.5 dBFS 1.8 MHz input. The power consumption is 16.9 mW with 1.2V/1.5V supplies. It results in a competitive FoM${}_{\mathrm {S\vert SNDR}}$of 172.2 dB, while it avoids any off-chip calibrations.

title_zh: 具有 3.6V/1.8V DM/CM 输入范围和 52.3mVpp/${\mu}$s 使用异步信号折叠恢复能力的抗伪电生理传感器接口
title_en: Artifact-Tolerant Electrophysiological Sensor Interface With 3.6V/1.8V DM/CM Input Range and 52.3mVpp/${\mu}$s Recovery Using Asynchronous Signal Folding
authors: Yong Lian；Guoxing Wang；Yanxing Suo；Xinzi Xu；Guanghua Qian；Yongfu Li；Yang Zhao；Qiao Cai
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 在可穿戴传感器的实际实现中，大幅度的运动伪影通常会导致信号链饱和，从而显着降低生物电信号的完整性。同样，在闭环脑刺激治疗过程中，快速刺激伪影是不可避免的，这给实时信号采集带来了额外的挑战。为了解决幅度达到数百毫伏的运动和刺激伪影，同时最大限度地减少信息丢失，具有高输入范围和快速伪影恢复能力的传感器接口至关重要。本文提出了一种连续时间跟踪和缩放（CT-TAZ）技术，旨在处理不饱和的大型伪影事件。所提出的系统实现了 3.6V/1.8V 差分电压...
abstract_en: In the practical implementations of wearable sensors, motion artifacts with large amplitudes often cause signal chain saturation, significantly degrading biopotential signal integrity. Similarly, rapid stimulation artifacts are inevitable during closed-loop brain stimulation therapy, posing additional challenges for real-time signal acquisition. To address motion and stimulation artifacts with amplitudes reaching hundreds of mV while minimizing information loss, a sensor interface with high input range and fast artifacts recovery capability is essential. This paper presents a continuous-time track-and-zoom (CT-TAZ) technique designed to handle large artifacts events without saturation. The proposed system achieves a 3.6V/1.8V differential-mode/common-mode full-scale input range. Fabricated in a 180nm CMOS process, the prototype chip occupies an area of 0.694mm2and consumes 12/32.6/51.6μW for recordings without/with single-end/ with differential rail-to-rail artifacts. The system demonstrates an average artifacts recovery time of 65.3 μs under 3.6V stimulation artifacts, achieving an average artifacts recovery speed of 52.3mVpp/μs, which is 2.25× larger input range and 3× faster recovery compared to the state-of-the-art.

title_zh: 具有紧凑型自适应均衡功能的 9.5pJ/位 40Mbps 准静态人体通道收发器
title_en: A 9.5-pJ/bit 40-Mbps Quasi-Static Body Channel Transceiver With Compact Adaptive Equalization
authors: Tao He；Yabin Zheng；Longyang Lin；Yongfu Li；Guoxing Wang；Jian ping Zhao
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 体耦合通信（BCC）的关键挑战是在动态变化的通道中实现高速、节能的数据传输，特别是解决准静态频带中运动和环境变化引起的主极点频率和通道增益的变化。本文提出了一种采用紧凑型自适应均衡 (CAE) 技术的宽带 BCC 收发器 (TRX)，以最小的功耗和硬件开销来补偿这些变化。 CAE 包括三个关键组件：用于同时增益和调零的零/增益可调均衡器 (ZGTE)、用于将均衡器的零锁定到通道极点的零极点锁定环路 (ZPLL) 以及用于跟踪通道增益波动的增益控制环路 (GCL)。 ...
abstract_en: The key challenge in body-coupled communication (BCC) is achieving high-speed and energy-efficient data transmission in dynamically varying channels, particularly addressing variations in dominant pole frequency and channel gain caused by motion and environmental changes in the quasi-static band. This article proposes a broadband BCC transceiver (TRX) with a compact adaptive equalization (CAE) technique to compensate for these variations with minimal power and hardware overhead. The CAE includes three key components: a zero/gain tunable equalizer (ZGTE) for simultaneous gain and zero tuning, a zero-pole locking loop (ZPLL) to lock the equalizer’s zero to the channel pole, and a gain control loop (GCL) to track fluctuations in channel gain. Fabricated in a 180-nm CMOS process, the prototype demonstrates a$49.7\times $reduction in bit error rate (BER) and a$1.59\times $improvement in eye opening with ZPLL and GCL enabled, as measured in a 60-cm dynamic in vivo test. The system operates at a data rate of 40 Mbps with an energy efficiency of 9.5 pJ/bit for PAM-4 modulation.

authors: Lei Qian；Guoxing Wang；Songyu Han；Xinglei Song；Pujia Xing；Timothy G. Constandinou；Yang Lin；Yan Liu；Peng Yan；Chen Wang；Yue Cao；Xinguo Wang

abstract_zh: 同时进行电生理学和化学记录可实现多模式神经仪器，并提供对跨细胞膜的化学突触和离子通道的深入了解。然而，模间干扰会阻碍具有高时间和空间分辨率的大规模系统中的高度同步记录。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种 1024 通道 CMOS 实验室系统，用于具有像素内数字化和干扰抑制的双模态神经记录。在像素内实施具有可调电容的前景校准方案，以补偿电记录和化学记录之间的串扰。电气和化学模式的有源像素是基于脉宽调制 (PWM) 分析而设计的。
abstract_en: Simultaneous electrophysiological and chemical recording allows for multi-modal neural instrumentation and provides insights into chemical synapses and ion channels across the cell membrane. However, inter-modal interference can hinder highly synchronized recording in large-scale systems with high temporal and spatial resolution. In this work, we propose a 1024-channel lab-on-CMOS system for dual-modal neural recording with in-pixel digitization and interference suppression. A foreground calibration scheme with tunable capacitance is implemented in-pixel to compensate for the crosstalk between electrical and chemical recording. Active pixels for both electrical and chemical modalities are designed based on a pulse width modulation (PWM) analog-to-digital conversion scheme. CMOS-compatible post-processing is implemented to realize in-pixel electrodes and chemical sensing membranes. The prototype, implemented in a 180 nm CMOS technology, occupies a total area of 33 mm2with 1024 pixels, and each unit pixel includes one electrical recording site and two chemical recording sites, with dimensions of 150$\mu$m$\times$130$\mu$m. The total system power consumption is 19.68 mW at a frame rate of 9k and 3k for electrical and chemical imaging respectively. Thein-vitroexperiment demonstrated the concurrent high density electrophysilogical and electrochemical recording with sub millisecond temporal resolution.

abstract_zh: 功能性近红外光谱 (fNIRS) 系统由于其移动性和灵活性而特别适合精神病学研究 [1]。频域 (FD) NIRS 利用多个源-探测器距离 (MD) 或载波频率 (MF) 来评估不同组织深度的光学特性，两种方法都能产生可比较的结果 [2]。虽然 MF FD-NIRS 更为复杂，但它对光源-探测器耦合变化不太敏感，因此可以使用更少的光学组件实现更紧凑的系统。然而，大多数现有工作都集中在基于 MD 的方法 [3-5]，对 MF 方法的探索有限 [6]。当前的 MF FD-NIRS 电路仍然面临两个主要挑战（图 1）：首先，尽管动态架构已经...
abstract_en: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) systems are particularly suited for psychiatric studies due to their mobility and flexibility [1]. Frequency-domain (FD) NIRS utilizes multiple source-detector distances (MD) or carrier frequencies (MF) to assess optical properties at varying tissue depths, with both methods yielding comparable results [2]. While MF FD-NIRS is more complex, it is less sensitive to light source-detector coupling variations, enabling more compact systems with fewer optical components. However, most existing work has focused on MD-based approaches [3–5], with limited exploration of MF methods [6]. Current MF FD-NIRS circuits still faces two main challenges (Fig. 1): First, although dynamic architecture has been proposed to decouple resolution from power consumption [4], using the same power across different carrier frequencies still limits energy efficiency. Second, avalanche photodiode’s (APD) intensity-phase crosstalk [7] and common offset complicate the accurate determination of metabolite concentrations, leading to diagnostic inaccuracies. Moreover, offset calibration requires additional hardware, increasing system complexity and cost.

abstract_en: The lithography process inherently introduces device-to-device variation in the fabrication of resistive random-access memory (RRAM) array, introducing electrical mismatch and limiting the practical applications of RRAM-based analog computing circuits. In this work, we propose a lithography model-aware layout synthesis framework to minimize the proximity effect in the lithography process, thus reducing the electrical mismatch amongst these devices for analog computing applications. A dummy RRAM cell insertion technique is proposed to reduce the geometrical mismatch among RRAM cells, and a bi-objective alternate optimization method is proposed to efficiently optimize the geometric parameters and the structure of RRAM layouts. In addition, an approximation method for evaluating the quality of the RRAM array layout is proposed to reduce the runtime of synthesis. The experimental results show that our proposed framework significantly reduces the deviation between printed and expected patterns.

abstract_zh: 心血管疾病（CVD）仍然是全球死亡的主要原因，凸显了持续生命体征监测的必要性。光电体积描记法 (PPG) 非常适合可穿戴设备。智能戒指受益于密集的毛细管分布和最小的组织干扰，可以舒适地捕获高质量的 PPG 信号，使其成为有前途的下一代可穿戴设备。然而，环相对于手指的旋转会改变光路，特别是对于多波长光，从而降低精度。本文提出了一种用于智能戒指的旋转鲁棒性 PPG 传感器。蒙特卡罗模拟分析了不同 LED 光电二极管 (PD) 角度下的光子传输，表明在 ±60° 时，绿光、红光和红外光可实现...
abstract_en: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) remains the leading cause of global mortality, highlighting the need for continuous vital sign monitoring. Photoplethysmography (PPG) is well suited for wearable devices. Smart rings, benefiting from dense capillary distribution and minimal tissue interference, can capture high-quality PPG signals with comfort, making them a promising next-generation wearable. However, ring rotation relative to the finger alters the optical path, especially for multi-wavelength light, thus reducing accuracy. This paper proposes a rotation-robust PPG sensor for smart rings. Monte Carlo simulations analyze photon transmission under different LED-photodiode (PD) angles, showing that at ±60°, green, red, and infrared light achieve optimal penetration into the microcirculation layer. Considering non-ideal conditions, the green-light angle is adjusted to ±30°, and a symmetrical sensor design is adopted. A prototype smart ring is developed, capable of recording 4-channel PPG, 3-axis acceleration, and 4-channel temperature signals at 100, 25, and 0.2 Hz, respectively. The system achieves reliable PPG acquisition with only 0.59 mA average current consumption. In continuous testing, heart rate estimation reached mean absolute errors of 0.82, 0.79, and 0.78 bpm for green, red, and IR light. The results provide a reference for future smart ring development.

authors: Guoxing Wang；Qianhui Guo；Bin Liu；Jiguang Wang；Yibang Cheng；Jiahui Xia；Xinzi Xu；Tingyan Xu；Hongbo Guo；Yi Chen；Hao Wu

abstract_zh: 多模态生物医学时间序列 (MBTS) 数据提供了生理状态的整体视图，在各种生物医学应用中具有重要意义。由于固有的噪声和不同模式之间的分布差距，MBTS 的建模可能很复杂。人们已经开发了各种深度学习模型来学习 MBTS 的表示，但由于忽略模态到模态的变化，鲁棒性仍然不足。本文提出了一种多尺度、多模式生物医学时间序列表示学习（MBSL）网络，通过对比学习来迁移这些变化。首先，MBTS 根据模态间距离进行分组，然后每个具有最小模态内变化的组可以通过单独的模型进行有效建模。
abstract_en: Multi-modal biomedical time series (MBTS) data offers a holistic view of the physiological state, holding significant importance in various bio-medical applications. Owing to inherent noise and distribution gaps across different modalities, MBTS can be complex to model. Various deep learning models have been developed to learn representations of MBTS but still fall short in robustness due to the ignorance of modal-to-modal variations. This paper presents a multi-scale and multi-modal biomedical time series representation learning (MBSL) network with contrastive learning to migrate these variations. Firstly, MBTS is grouped based on inter-modal distances, then each group with minimum intra-modal variations can be effectively modeled by individual encoders. Besides, to enhance the multi-scale feature extraction (encoder), various patch lengths and mask ratios are designed to generate tokens with semantic information at different scales and diverse contextual perspectives respectively. Finally, cross-modal contrastive learning is proposed to maximize consistency among inter-modal groups, maintaining useful information and eliminating noises. Experiments against four bio-medical applications show that MBSL outperforms state-of-the-art models by 33.9% mean average errors (MAE) in respiration rate, by 13.8% MAE in exercise heart rate, by 1.41% accuracy in human activity recognition, and by 1.14% F1-score in obstructive sleep apnea-hypopnea syndrome.

abstract_en: The article highlights the role of open-source initiatives in technological innovation through the IEEE CAS Society’s grand challenges. The challenges act as catalysts, bridging academic research, industry needs, and creativity to produce open-source datasets, ML/DL models, and setting performance benchmarks. The development of open-source datasets involves complex data collection and maintenance processes, balancing data quality with privacy concerns. The grand challenges are structured in stages, with strict rules to maintain integrity and foster innovation. These initiatives contribute significantly to the development of industry standards, with participants influencing standardization processes. The case study on the Respiratory Sound Grand Challenge exemplifies this impact, demonstrating the challenges’ role in advancing digital stethoscope technology and setting up the stage for IEEE Digital Stethoscope Standard Working Group, P3435 with industry benchmarks.

abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 展示了执行各种自然语言任务的能力，这对于医疗保健事件预测应用程序至关重要，尤其是来自可穿戴设备数据的预测。然而，目前的微调方法有很大的局限性。泛化性能不足导致任务迁移困难，且使用GPT直接推理的方案存在隐私问题。本文提出了一种迭代情境学习框架，应用于四个可穿戴设备数据集（PMData、LifeSnaps、GLOBEM 和 AW_FB）的 10 项任务。该框架迭代地过滤用例并使用 GPT-4 对其进行验证，对 Llama3-8B 模型进行推理。它在以下 6 项任务上实现了 SOTA 性能...
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate the ability to perform a wide range of natural language tasks being crucial in healthcare event prediction applications, particularly from wearable device data. However, the current fine-tuning method has great limitations. Inadequate generalization performance leads to difficulty in migrating tasks, and the solution of using GPT for direct reasoning has privacy problems. This paper presents an Iterative In-Context Learning framework applied to 10 tasks across four wearable device datasets (PMData, LifeSnaps, GLOBEM, and AW_FB). The framework iteratively filters use cases and validates them using GPT-4, performing inference on the Llama3-8B model. It achieves SOTA performance on 6 of the tasks under the same scale model, with an average performance increase of$\mathbf{1 2. 5 4 \%}$. Ablation studies demonstrate the framework's efficacy. We also compared the fine-tuning model and the utilization of our method on training time and resources, and the results show that our method is more efficient.

abstract_zh: 生物信号采集前端的自适应阻抗增强对于可穿戴和植入式设备至关重要，因为在这些设备中，传感器表现出高源阻抗且分布范围较大。本文介绍了一种基于脉宽调制（PWM）的电容耦合斩波压控振荡器（VCO）的连续时间$\mathrm {\Delta \Sigma }$调制器（CTDSM），用于生物电位监测。提出了一种基于 PWM 的正反馈环路来消除芯片内部的耦合和去耦效应，从而通过简化的校准数模转换器 (DAC) 来提高输入阻抗。提出了频域环路稳定性检测，以通过全数字实现连续监控 VCO 输出......
abstract_en: Adaptive impedance boosting for bio-signal acquisition front end is essential for wearable and implantable devices, where the sensor exhibits a high source impedance with a large spread. A pulsewidth-modulation (PWM)-based capacitively coupled chopped voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO)-based continuous-time$\mathrm {\Delta \Sigma }$modulator (CTDSM) for bio-potential monitoring is presented in this article. A PWM-based positive feedback loop is proposed to cancel the coupling and decoupling effect inside the chip, thus boosting the input impedance with simplified calibration digital to analog converter (DAC). A frequency-domain loop stability detection is proposed to continuously monitor the VCO outputs with a fully digital implementation. Therefore, a background auto-calibration scheme is developed to achieve sub-second convergence time. The proposed VCO-based neural front end was fabricated in a 180-nm CMOS process. With a chopping frequency of 640 kHz, the prototype achieves 1.84-$\mu $Vrms input-referred noise (IRN) from 0.07-Hz to 1-kHz bandwidth. With a linear input range of 150 mVpp, it exhibits an signal to noise and distortion ratio (SNDR) of 72.4 dB and a dynamic range (DR) of 90.2 dB. With a chopping frequency of 10 kHz, it exhibits an IRN of$3.09~{\mu }$Vrms, an SNDR of 81.0 dB, and a DR of 85.7 dB. In addition, an input impedance of 8.73 G$\Omega $is achieved at 2 Hz.

abstract_zh: 具有异构内存处理 (PIM) 内核的片上网络 (NoC) 加速器比神经网络的同构加速器具有更优越的性能。专用模拟器和架构搜索框架对于获取性能、功耗和面积 (PPA) 指标以及指导设计过程至关重要。然而，现有的模拟器主要是为同构NoC设计的，缺乏对模拟基于PIM的异构NoC架构的支持。此外，当前异构NoC架构的搜索框架仅关注工作负载分配和映射策略，未能在更大的设计空间中探索异构PIM配置。在这项工作中，我们提出了 HPIM-NoC，一种联合模拟和搜索框架...
abstract_en: Network-on-Chip (NoC) accelerators with heterogeneous Processing-in-Memory (PIM) cores achieve superior performance than homogeneous ones for neural networks. Dedicated simulators and architecture search frameworks are pivotal for obtaining performance, power, and area (PPA) metrics, as well as guiding the design process. However, existing simulators are primarily designed for homogeneous NoC and lack support for simulating heterogeneous PIM-based NoC architectures. Besides, current search frameworks for heterogeneous NoC architectures only focus on workload allocation and mapping strategies, failing to explore heterogeneous PIM configurations in a larger design space. In this work, we propose HPIM-NoC, a joint simulation and search framework for heterogeneous PIM-based NoC architectures. HPIM-NoC not only supports the simulation of heterogeneous PIM cores, but also provides more accurate latency results by introducing NoC transmission delays and pipelines in co-simulation. HPIM-NoC implements a three-stage heterogeneous search process based on priori knowledge and employs a specific simulated annealing algorithm tailored for heterogeneous architecture search. The search process is accelerated by precomputing core PPA metrics and reducing NoC simulation frequency. In addition, the framework integrates a customized layout algorithm to optimize the placement of heterogeneous NoC, minimizing communication latency and overall area. Experimental results on various neural networks demonstrate that HPIM-NoC can quickly find near-optimal configurations within a limited time. The proposed acceleration method reduces the search time of HPIM-NoC by $2.12 \times$, $2.17 \times$, and $2.96 \times$, respectively. Compared to homogeneous architectures, the Fusions of Metrics (FoMs) of heterogeneous PIM-based NoC architectures found by HPIM-NoC are reduced by $\mathbf{1. 1 8 \%, ~} \mathbf{1 6. 9 4 \%}$, and $\mathbf{3 7. 4 1 \%}$ for ResNet-18 under three settings, respectively.

abstract_zh: 血压（BP）是人体健康的重要生命指标。持续监测血压水平是全世界的迫切需求，因为连续血压读数可以为评估心血管健康状况提供更丰富的信息。由于传统的基于袖带的监测方法不方便且会给用户带来痛苦，基于光电容积脉搏波描记法（PPG）的血压监测方法因其可以无袖带地提供连续血压而引起了极大的关注。在本文中，我们利用可穿戴智能戒指PPG信号和高效的移动网络来实现无袖血压监测。我们首先在开源VitalDB数据集上训练模型，然后将模型传输到自收集的RingConn-Sta...
abstract_en: Blood pressure (BP) is an important vital indicator of human health. Continuous monitoring of BP levels is an urgent demand worldwide, as continuous BP readings can provide richer information for the evaluation of cardiovascular health conditions. As the traditional cuff-based monitoring method is inconvenient and can cause pain to users, the photoplethes-mogoraphy(PPG) based blood pressure monitoring methods have attracted great attention because they can offer continuous blood pressure cufflessly. In this paper, we use the wearable smart ring PPG signal and efficient mobile network to monitor blood pressure cufflessly. We first train the model on the open-source VitalDB dataset, and then transfer the model to a self-collected RingConn-StaticBP dataset. Extensive experiments show that transfer learning technology, personalization calibration, demographic features, and BP_LEVEL feature can improve the accuracy of blood pressure estimation. Among VitalDB 185 test subjects, the best mean error (ME)±standard deviation error(SDE) for SBP is 1.432±8.091 mmHg, and ME±SDE for DBP are 0.731±4.565 mmHg, which almost meets the AAMI standard. After personalizing the model pre-trained with VitalDB, the ME±SDE is 0.978±4.773 mmHg for SBP, and 0.737±3.396 mmHg for DBP in the RingConn-StaticBP dataset. The results show the effectiveness and potential of continuously measuring blood pressure without cuffs using a wearable smart ring.

abstract_zh: 代谢物浓度的无创定量在医学诊断和监测领域具有重要意义。功能近红外光谱（NIRS）为此目的提供了一种有前景的光学解决方案。然而，传统的连续波 (CW) NIRS 系统仅记录光强度，限制了对物质中光吸收 (μa) 和减少散射 (μs’) 系数波动的分析 [1-2]。这阻碍了获得绝对代谢物浓度，限制了该技术的实用性。频域 (FD) NIRS 将强度调制光发射到人体组织中，从而可以同时测量光强度损失和光飞行时间 (ToF) 的变化。然后它决定了绝对的我......
abstract_en: The non-invasive quantification of metabolite concentration is of significant importance in the fields of medical diagnosis and monitoring. Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) offers a promising optical solution for this purpose. However, conventional continuous-wave (CW) NIRS systems only record light intensity, limiting analysis of optical absorption (μa) and reduced scattering (μs’) coefficient fluctuations in substances [1–2]. This hinders obtaining absolute metabolite concentrations, limiting the technology’s utility. Frequency-domain (FD) NIRS emits intensity-modulated light into human tissues, allowing simultaneous measurement of changes in optical intensity loss and light time-of-flight (ToF). It then determines absolute metabolite concentrations,.addressing key needs in brain functional imaging, drug metabolism studies and cancer diagnosis.

title_zh: 采用 22nm FDSOI 的 0.72nW、0.006mm2 32kHz 晶体振荡器，具有 -40°C 至 125°C 的自适应次谐波脉冲注入
title_en: A 0.72nW, 0.006mm2 32kHz Crystal Oscillator with Adaptive Sub-Harmonic Pulse Injection from -40°C to 125°C in 22nm FDSOI
authors: Yingjie Zhu；Guoxing Wang；Humiao Li；Yida Li；Yiqing Lan；Longyang Lin；Haoran Lyu；Zhen Kong；Jiamin Li；Jian Zhao
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 提出了一种可在较宽温度范围内工作的亚纳瓦级、基于单电源脉冲注入的晶体振荡器 (XO)。谷值注入定时自适应电路在 58.8pW 时针对 PVT 变化实现了 <±7% 的误 差。此外，注入失真补偿和振荡直流稳定技术可将峰值注入定时偏差降低 7 倍。 22nm FDSOI 中的 IC 在 0.72nW 和 0.006mm2 下实现了 11ppb Allan 偏差底限，并实现了 −40°C 至 125°C 的最宽温度范围。
abstract_en: A sub-nW, single-supply pulse-injection-based crystal oscillator (XO) that operates across a wide temperature range is presented. The valley-injection timing adaptation circuit achieves <±7% inaccuracy against PVT variations at 58.8pW. Moreover, the injection distortion compensation and oscillation DC stabilizing techniques achieve 7× lower peak-injection timing deviation. The IC in 22nm FDSOI achieves a 11ppb Allan deviation floor at 0.72nW and 0.006mm2, and enables the widest reported temperature range of −40°C to 125°C.

abstract_zh: 光电体积描记法（PPG）是一种常用的无创生物信号检测技术，可以分析心率和血氧饱和度，在日常健康监测中发挥着重要作用。在图 1（上）中，将生物采集集成到智能戒指中是消费电子产品的新兴趋势 [1]。然而，将所有构建模块集成到空间有限的设备中会遇到挑战。也给用户带来了不适。一种可行的集成解决方案是将硅芯片焊接到柔性基板上，这需要昂贵的封装[2]。半柔性系统限制了其弯曲性，仍然需要广泛的动态范围 (DR) 来减轻运动伪影 [3]。
abstract_en: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is a commonly used non-invasive biological signal detection technique that can analyze the heart rate and blood oxygen saturation, which plays an important role in daily health monitoring. In Fig. 1 (top), integrating biological acquisition into smart rings is an emerging trend in the consumer electronics [1]. However, integrating all building blocks into a space-limited device encounters challenges. It also bring discomfort to the users. A feasible integrate solution is soldering Si chips onto a flexible substrate which requires costly packaging [2]. The semi flexible system constrains its bendability, still requiring an extensive dynamic range (DR) to mitigate motion artifacts [3].

title_zh: 采用 65nm CMOS 的 15MHz-BW 82.7dB-SNDR 98.8dB-SFDR 流水线 MASH 2-2 CT DSM
title_en: A 15MHz-BW 82.7dB-SNDR 98.8dB-SFDR Pipelined MASH 2-2 CT DSM in 65nm CMOS
authors: Yichen Jin；Yong Lian；Guoxing Wang；Xinyu Qin；Maurits Ortmanns；Liang Qi；Sai-Weng Sin
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 单环路 CT DSM 结合了低阶 CT 环路和噪声整形量化器 (NS-QTZ)，在 80dB+ SNDR 和 10MHz+ BW 的性能范围内展现出高功率效率 [1]、[2]。如此不错的功效主要归功于 NS-QTZ 的高效量化。例如，在[1]中，使用4b二阶噪声整形SAR的QTZ在OSR为20时提供了有效的8b分辨率。然而，与闪存QTZ的并行数字化相比，NS-QTZ串行执行量化和积分，这需要更长的时间。因此，随着采样频率 (Fs) 的增加，它可能不可行。
abstract_en: A single-loop CT DSM, combining a low-order CT loop and noise-shaped quantizer (NS-QTZ), demonstrates high power efficiency in the performance range of 80dB+ SNDR & 10MHz+ BW [1], [2]. Such decent power efficiency is primarily attributed to the highly efficient quantization of NS-QTZ. For instance, in [1], the QTZ using a 4b 2nd- order noise-shaping SAR provides an effective 8b resolution at the OSR of 20. However, compared with the parallel digitization of flash QTZ, the NS-QTZ performs quantization and integration in series, which takes longer time. Hence, it might not be viable as the sampling frequency (Fs) increases.

title_zh: 采用混频器优先模拟前端和 $\Sigma$-$\Delta$ 相数转换器的节能 FD-fNIRS 读出电路
title_en: An Energy-Efficient FD-fNIRS Readout Circuit Employing a Mixer-First Analog Frontend and a $\Sigma$-$\Delta$ Phase-to-Digital Converter
authors: Xia Bi；Guoxing Wang；Cheng Chen；Yuxiang Lin；Zhouchen Ma；Mohamad Sawan；Jian Zhao；Liang Qi；Yongfu Li

abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种低功率频域功能近红外光谱（FD-fNIRS）读出电路，用于组织光学特性的绝对值测量。该论文提出了一种混频器优先的模拟前端（AFE）结构和一个1位Σ-Δ相位数字转换器（PDC），以减少所需的电路带宽和激光调制频率，从而在保持高分辨率的同时节省功耗。所提出的芯片可实现低于 0.01° 的相位分辨率，功耗为 6.8 mW。生产了九个光学实体模型来评估芯片。与自建的网络分析仪与雪崩光电二极管（APD）模块相结合的高精度测量平台相比，该网络分析仪的最大测量误差...
abstract_en: This paper presents a low-power frequency-domain functional near-infrared spectroscopy (FD-fNIRS) readout circuit for the absolute value measurement of tissue optical characteristics. The paper proposes a mixer-first analog front-end (AFE) structure and a 1-bit Σ-Δ phase-to-digital converter (PDC) to reduce the required circuit bandwidth and the laser modulation frequency, thereby saving power while maintaining high resolution. The proposed chip achieves sub-0.01° phase resolution and consumes 6.8 mW of power. Nine optical solid phantoms are produced to evaluate the chip. Compared to a self-built high-precision measurement platform that combines a network analyzer with an avalanche photodiode (APD) module, the maximum measuring errors of the absorption coefficient and reduced scattering coefficient are 10.6% and 12.3%, respectively.

title_en: Compressed Frequency-Division Multiplexing Sampling Technique for High-Density NearInfrared Brain Functional Imaging Photoelectric Array
venue: IEEE Biomedical Circuits and Systems Conference (BioCAS)
authors: Zisheng Dai；Zhouchen Ma；Yuxiang Lin；Yan Wu；Guoxing Wang；Mohamad Sawan；Jian ping Zhao；Cheng Chen

abstract_zh: 多通道和高密度 fNIRS 系统对于提供详细且全面的大脑活动图谱、增强对神经过程的理解至关重要。目前，fNIRS 主要采用时分复用从每个通道顺序收集数据。然而，随着通道数量的增加，时间分辨率显着恶化。因此，保持 fNIRS 设备的高时间分辨率是这项工作的主要目标。因此，本研究引入压缩频分复用（FDM）采样技术，考虑光衰减原理和设备的光电布置，仅利用四个载波频率开发多通道...
abstract_en: Multi-channel and high-density fNIRS systems are crucial for providing detailed and comprehensive brain activity mapping, enhancing the understanding of neural processes. Currently, fNIRS primarily employs time-division multiplexing to sequentially collect data from each channel. However, as the number of channels increases, the time resolution significantly deteriorates. Therefore, maintaining high temporal resolution of fNIRS device represents the primary objective of this work. Therefore, this study introduces a compressed frequency-division multiplexing(FDM) sampling technique, considering the principle of light attenuation and the optoelectronic arrangement of the equipment, utilizing just four carrier frequencies to develop a multi-channel fNIRS system. This research verified the proposed solution through deployment on an FPGA platform and the measurement results ensures high temporal resolution of the device within highdensity fNIRS system photoelectric arrays.

title_zh: 基于大面积 LTPS-TFT 的双向生物医学接口，具有工艺不变的像素内生物电势数字转换器
title_en: A Large-Area LTPS-TFT-Based Bi-directional Biomedical Interface with Process-Invariant In-pixel Biopotential-to-Digital Converters
authors: Guoxing Wang；Hanbo Zhang；Yuqing Lou；Fakhrul Z. Rokhani；Zhihang Zhang；Yongfu Li；Jian Zhao
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们展示了一种基于 LTPS-TFT 的双向生物医学过程不变像素接口，集成了前端放大器、模数转换器和刺激器。像素接口可以将生物电势转换成数字信号。这种近传感器信号处理可以避免运动伪影的干扰，并且全数字传输具有很高的噪声容限。在1×-1.4×阈值电压的工艺变化和±10%迁移率波动的情况下，运算放大器的DC增益从58.83dB变化到57.21dB，前端放大器的DC增益从39.09dB变化到37.88dB。与单级放大器相比，稳定性提高了13.2倍。所提出的伪差分 VCO-b...
abstract_en: In this paper, we demonstrate a bi-directional biomedical process-invariant pixel interface based on the LTPS-TFT that integrates a front-end amplifier, an analog-to-digital converter and a stimulator. The pixel interface can convert biopotential into digital signals. This near-sensor signal processing can avoid the interference of motion artifacts, and the all-digital transfer has a high noise tolerance. Under the process variation of 1×-1.4× threshold voltage and ±10% mobility fluctuations, the DC gain of the operational amplifier changes from 58.83 dB to 57.21 dB, and 39.09 dB to 37.88 dB for the front-end amplifier. Compared with the single-stage amplifier, the stability has been improved by 13.2×. The proposed pseudo differential VCO-based ADC can effectively eliminate second-order non-linearity which achieves the best performance in state-of-the-art TFT-ADCs. When the threshold voltage and mobility fluctuate, ENOB changes from 7.36 bit to 7.30 bit (OSR=64) and 11.52 bit to 11.14 bit (OSR=256). The change rate does not exceed 4%.

title_zh: 具有 128/256 可重构神经元和异步全连接突触的 0.67 至 5.4 TSOPs/W 脉冲神经网络加速器
title_en: A 0.67-to-5.4 TSOPs/W Spiking Neural Network Accelerator With 128/256 Reconfigurable Neurons and Asynchronous Fully Connected Synapses
authors: Kea-Tiong Tang；Guoxing Wang；Yuqing Lou；Xiangting Li；Xiangao Qi；Yongfu Li；Jian Zhao
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练

abstract_zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）因其探索人脑复杂性并利用其功能的潜力而受到越来越多的关注。广泛的应用对设计基于 SNN 的神经拟态系统提出了挑战。首先，SNN 使用复杂的模型（例如用于大脑模拟的 Izhikevich (IZ)）和更简单的模型（例如用于高效机器学习的 Leaky Integrate and Fire (LIF)），这对实现支持不同应用的神经元电路提出了挑战。其次，尖峰分布不均匀的密集连接网络会导致片上网络 (NoC) 拥塞和延迟，从而使吞吐量/面积的优化变得复杂。一个 SNN 加速器，具有 128/256 个可重构神经元和...
abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are garnering increasing attention due to their potential to explore the complexities of the human brain and utilize its capabilities. The broad spectrum of applications presents challenges in designing SNN-based neuromorphic systems First, the SNN uses complex models e.g., Izhikevich (IZ) for brain simulations and simpler models e.g., Leaky Integrate and Fire (LIF) for efficient machine learning, presenting a challenge in realizing neuron circuits supporting diverse applications. Second, densely connected networks with uneven spike distributions lead to Network-on-Chip (NoC) congestion and delays, complicating the optimization of throughput/area. An SNN accelerator, featuring 128/256 reconfigurable neurons and asynchronous fully connected synapses, has been developed to address these challenges. The reconfigurable neuron circuit is capable of switching between the LIF neuron model and the IZ neuron model. The proposed chip achieves a peak power efficiency of 5.37 TSOPs/W and throughput of 25.6 MSOPs/s. The near-threshold operation of neurons, in conjunction with asynchronous fully connected synapse, reduces energy by 9.42$\times$to a 9.27 pJ/pixel in image feature extraction.

title_zh: 具有动态架构和无交叉耦合强度和相位数字转换器的 2.2ps 飞行时间分辨率频域 fNIRS 读出 IC
title_en: A 2.2-ps Time-of-Flight Resolution Frequency-Domain fNIRS Readout IC With a Dynamic Architecture and Cross-Coupling-Free Intensity and Phase-to-Digital Converter
authors: Zhouchen Ma；Yuxiang Lin；Cheng Chen；Xiangao Qi；Yongfu Li；Kea‐Tiong Tang；Fa Wang；Tianhong Zhang；Guoxing Wang；Jian ping Zhao

abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种完全集成的频域 (FD) 功能近红外光谱 (fNIRS) 检测集成电路 (IC)，专为组织代谢物光学特性的非侵入式测量而设计。与传统的静态架构不同，提出了一种动态光传感架构，该架构允许通过占空比调制将飞行时间（ToF）分辨率与系统功耗解耦，从而提高能源效率。此外，为了提高ToF和强度损失的测量精度，提出了一种内部稳定的强度和相位数字转换器（IS-IPDC）来解决强度和相位量化之间的耦合问题。该芯片实现...
abstract_en: This article presents a fully integrated frequency-domain (FD) functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) detection integrated circuit (IC) designed for non-invasive measurement of tissue metabolite optical properties. Departing from traditional static architectures, a dynamic light sensing architecture is proposed, which allows for the decoupling of time-of-flight (ToF) resolution from the system power consumption through duty-cycle modulation, thereby enhancing energy efficiency. In addition, to improve the measurement precision of both ToF and intensity loss, an inter-stabilized intensity and phase-to-digital converter (IS-IPDC) is proposed to resolve coupling issues between intensity and phase quantification. The chip is implemented in a standard 180-nm CMOS process. Test results indicate that the light ToF resolution is 2.2 ps within a 10-Hz bandwidth, while consuming only 12.5 mW. Thanks to its high resolution and crosstalk-free characteristics, compared with the high-precision instrument-based reference system, the maximum measurement errors for the absorption coefficient ($\boldsymbol {\mu _{a}}$) and reduced scattering coefficient ($\boldsymbol {\mu '_{s}}$) are 4.2% and 4%, respectively. Finally, comprehensive in vitro and in vivo demonstrations demonstrate the IC’s capabilities for metabolic imaging and long-term monitoring.

title_zh: 使用 CT 跟踪和缩放的无饱和 3.6V/1.8V DM/CM 输入范围 46.6mV/μs 伪影恢复传感器接口
title_en: A Saturation-Free 3.6V/1.8V DM/CM Input Range 46.6mV/μs Artifacts Recovery Sensor Interface using CT Track-and-Zoom
authors: Yong Lian；Guoxing Wang；Yanxing Suo；Guanghua Qian；Xinzi Xu；Yongfu Li；Yang Zhao；Qiao Cai
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: ExG 记录中因运动、环境干扰和刺激而产生的伪影可表现为共模 (CM)、差模 (DM) 或高达数百 mV 的 CM/DM 信号混合。为了减轻这些伪影并最大限度地减少信息丢失，需要具有高输入范围和快速响应速度的传感器接口 (SI)。与使用耗电的高动态范围 (DR) ADC 相比，已经开发出各种伪影恢复方法，包括自适应滤波器 [1]、跟踪和缩放 [2]、自适应增益控制 [3] 和共模电荷泵 [4]，展示了令人印象深刻的功效，但代价是信号分辨率降低或恢复速度有限。本文提出了一种连续时间跟踪和缩放（...
abstract_en: Artifacts in ExG recordings resulting from motion, environment interferences and stimulation can manifest as common mode (CM), differential mode (DM) or hybrid of CM/DM signals with up to hundreds of mV. To mitigate these artifacts and minimize information loss, a sensor interface (SI) with high input range and fast response speed is required. In contrast to the use of power-hungry high dynamic range (DR) ADCs, various artifact recovery approaches including adaptive filter [1], track-and-zoom [2], adaptive gain control [3] and common-mode charge pump [4] have been developed demonstrating impressive power efficiency, but at the cost of reduced signal resolution or limited recovery speed. This paper presents a continuous-time track-and-zoom (CT-TAZ) technique to address large artifact events with a saturation-free SI with 3.6V/1.8V DM/CM full-scale input range, owing to a hybrid analog-digital asynchronous signal folder (ASF) that constrains the signal within the predefined constant window in current domain. The signal can be recovered within 73 μs under 3.6V stimulation artifacts, achieving 46.6mV/μs artifact recovery speed, which is 2.25~47.3X larger and 3.56~311X faster than the state-of-the-art.

title_zh: 适用于大面积医疗保健应用的完全基于 LTPS-TFT 的双向生物医学接口电路
title_en: A Fully LTPS-TFT-Based Bidirectional Biomedical Interface Circuit for Large-Area Healthcare Applications
authors: Hanbo Zhang；Yuqing Lou；Zhihang Zhang；Yongfu Li；Fakhrul Zaman Rokhani；Guoxing Wang；Jian ping Zhao
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练

abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于全低温多晶硅薄膜晶体管（LTPS-TFT）的双向生物医学像素接口，集成了高线性度刺激器和高性能生物电势传感前端电路，用于放大和数字化生物信号，以实现高鲁棒性数据传输。所有电路均在$\text {3-}\mu \text {m}$LTPS 流程下设计和制造。我们在盐水中演示了实验，使用刺激器电路模拟生物体内部的刺激，在不同的占空比下实现不同平均电流的刺激。所提出的前端电路的增益为 40 dB。整个信号链的参考输入电压噪声为$86.2~\mu \text {V}/\sqr...
abstract_en: This article proposed a fully low-temperature polysilicon thin-film transistor (LTPS-TFT)-based bidirectional biomedical pixel interface integrated with a high linearity stimulator and a high-performance biopotential sensing front-end circuit to amplify and digitize biological signals for high robustness data transmission. All circuits are designed and manufactured under a$\text {3-}\mu \text {m}$LTPS process. We demonstrated the experiment in saline using the stimulator circuit to simulate stimulation inside the organism, achieving stimulation with different average currents under different duty cycles. The proposed front-end circuit has a gain of 40 dB. The referred input voltage noise of the entire signal chain is$86.2~\mu \text {V}/\sqrt {\text {Hz}}$, and the effective number of bits (ENOB) is 9.13 bits at an input of$0.5~\text {mV}_{\text {PP}}$. Simultaneously conducting statistical testing on 20 chips has achieved a 1.05 dB SNDR standard deviation. Finally, we use a function signal generator to simulate the input signals of electrocorticography (ECoG), electrocardiogram (ECG), and electrooculogram (EOG), then use front-end circuits to read and reconstruct them to demonstrate that the proposed pixel interface can correctly read common biomedical signals for healthcare applications.

abstract_en: Real-time monitoring of vital signs in wearable devices focuses on accurate photoplethysmogram (PPG) and electrocardiogram (ECG) recording. Motion artifacts, ambient light interference and sensor-skin contact variability affect signal quality significantly, demanding a multi-channel sensor interface chip with a high dynamic range and energy efficiency. A PPG/ECG SoC is proposed for robust signal optimization. Time-division multiplexing, ambient double sampling and DC current compensation together enhance the dynamic range. abstract_zh: 具有稳定和可调电导状态的突触器件中的量子电导（QC）行为对于高密度存储和类脑神经计算（NC）至关重要。在这项工作中，受蜘蛛丝中流体不连续传输的启发，设计了一种由嵌入硅量子点的氧化硅纳米线网络（Si-QDs@SiO x ）组成的突触装置。在SET和RESET过程中都实现了可调的QC行为，并且QC状态在突触装置中表现出超过10 4 s的稳定保留时间，并且在间隔两个月后表现出稳定的再现性。突触可塑性，包括长期增强/抑制和巴甫洛夫调节功能，是基于可调...
abstract_en: The quantum conductance (QC) behaviors in synaptic devices with stable and tunable conductance states are essential for high-density storage and brain-like neurocomputing (NC). In this work, inspired by the discontinuous transport of fluid in spider silk, a synaptic device composed of a silicon oxide nanowire network embedded with silicon quantum dots (Si-QDs@SiO x ) is designed. The tunable QC behaviors are achieved in both the SET and RESET processes, and the QC states exhibit stable retention time exceeding 10 4 s in the synaptic device and show stable reproducibility after an interval of two months. The synaptic plasticity, including long-term potentiation/depression and Pavlovian conditioning function, is simulated based on the tunable conductance. The mechanism of stable and tunable QC behaviors is analyzed and clarified by beading effect of spider silk in Si-QDs@SiO x nanowires structure. The digit recognition capability of the device is evaluated by simulation using an artificial neural network consisting of the Si-QDs@SiO x -based synaptic device. These results provide insights into the development of neurocomputing systems with high classification accuracy.

abstract_zh: 可穿戴设备通过长期监测实时生命体征，为主动健康提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，智能手表等腕戴式设备面临着不准确和信息丢失的问题。这主要是由于两个因素造成的：运动伪影，由于相对运动而干扰记录的信号，以及手腕的解剖复杂性，使传感器放置变得复杂，特别是对于需要光源和接收器最佳定位的光学传感器。光电体积描记法 (PPG) 是可穿戴设备记录的关键信号。由于手指血管密度高且静态组织少，因此是更适合 PPG 信号的测量部位。此外，指戴式设备可以更牢固地粘附在...
abstract_en: Wearables provide a promising solution for proactive health by monitoring real-time vital signs long-term. However, wrist-worn devices, like smartwatches, have faced issues with inaccuracy and information loss. This is primarily due to two factors: motion artifacts, which interfere with recorded signals due to relative movement, and the anatomical complexity of the wrist, complicating sensor placement, especially for optical sensors that require optimal positioning of light sources and receivers. Photoplethysmography (PPG) is a critical signal recorded by wearables. The Finger is a more suitable measurement site for PPG signals due to its high vascular density and few static tissues. Additionally, fingerworn devices adhere more securely to the skin than wrist-worn devices, reducing sensitivity to external interference and improving PPG signal quality. Advances in electronic devices have led to significant progress in smart rings, making them a promising next-generation wearable. This paper discusses the development, potential, and challenges of smart ring technologies. With accelerating research, we believe smart rings are poised to become a main player in the wearable market.

abstract_zh: 分谐波脉冲注入晶体振荡器可实现亚纳瓦级操作，并且在振荡峰值和谷值处的能量注入频率较低。然而，这对注入精度提出了严格的要求，影响了运行功率、抖动和可靠性。为了确保在宽温度范围内以最小的开销实现准确的谷值和峰值注入，这项工作提出了基于零电压检测（ZVD）的闭环定时自适应、不平衡差分注入和振荡直流稳定技术，用于基于单电源16次谐波脉冲注入的晶体振荡器（XO）。该 IC 采用 22 nm FDSOI 制造，可在报告的最宽温度范围内运行，从 $-40~^{\circ }$C 到 $125~^{\circ }$C，并且...
abstract_en: Subharmonic pulse injection crystal oscillators enable sub-nW operation with less frequent energy injection at oscillation peaks and valleys. However, this poses stringent requirements on the injection accuracy, which affects operation power, jitter, and reliability. To ensure accurate valley and peak injection across a wide temperature at minimum overhead, this work proposes the zero-voltage detection (ZVD)-based closed-loop timing adaptation, unbalanced differential injection and oscillation DC stabilizing techniques for a single-supply 16th subharmonic pulse-injection-based crystal oscillator (XO). Fabricated in 22-nm FDSOI, the IC enables operation across the widest reported temperature range from$-40~^{\circ }$C to$125~^{\circ }$C, and achieves a 11 ppb Allan deviation floor while consuming 0.72 nW and 0.006 mm2.

abstract_zh: 减少工艺变化是电阻式随机存取存储器 (RRAM) 的一个重要问题。由于其超高的集成密度，RRAM阵列在光刻过程中很容易出现光刻变化，从而在不同的RRAM器件之间引入电气变化。在这项工作中，开发了一种用于 RRAM 阵列的光学物理验证方法，并系统地研究了不同布局参数对重要电气特性的影响。结果表明，RRAM 器件根据其位置和光刻环境可以分为三类。读取电阻对阵列中的位置 (~30%) 比 SET/RESET 电压 (<10%) 更敏感。在...
abstract_en: Reducing the process variation is a significant concern for resistive random access memory (RRAM). Due to its ultra-high integration density, RRAM arrays are prone to lithographic variation during the lithography process, introducing electrical variation among different RRAM devices. In this work, an optical physical verification methodology for the RRAM array is developed, and the effects of different layout parameters on important electrical characteristics are systematically investigated. The results indicate that the RRAM devices can be categorized into three clusters according to their locations and lithography environments. The read resistance is more sensitive to the locations in the array (~30%) than SET/RESET voltage (<10%). The increase in the RRAM device length and the application of the optical proximity correction technique can help to reduce the variation to less than 10%, whereas it reduces RRAM read resistance by 4×, resulting in a higher power and area consumption. As such, we provide design guidelines to minimize the electrical variation of RRAM arrays due to the lithography process.

abstract_zh: 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停低通气综合征（OSAHS）是一个重大的公共卫生问题。智能戒指和智能手表等可穿戴设备为检测 OSAHS 的传统多导睡眠图 (PSG) 测试提供了一种更方便、侵入性更小的替代方案。智能戒指从指根收集信号，与智能手表的手腕信号相比，可提供卓越的信号质量和鲁棒性，使其成为 OSAHS 检测的更便捷选择。然而，目前还没有研究验证基于智能环的 OSAHS 检测的性能。据我们所知，我们是第一个研究使用智能戒指检测 OSAHS 的可行性和有效性的公司。我们分析了 58 名受试者，每个受试者都戴着...
abstract_en: Obstructive sleep apnea-hypopnea syndrome (OSAHS) is a significant public health concern. Wearable devices, such as smart rings and smart watches, provide a more convenient and less invasive alternative to traditional polysomnography (PSG) testing for detecting OSAHS. Smart rings, which collect signals from the finger base, offer superior signal quality and robustness compared to wrist signals from smart watches, making them a more convenient option for OSAHS detection. However, there is currently no research validating the performance of smart ring-based OSAHS detection. To our best knowledge, we are the first to investigate the feasibility and effectiveness of detecting OSAHS using smart rings. We analyzed 58 subjects, each wearing both a PSG device and RingConn smart rings for overnight OSAHS monitoring. Additionally, we propose a novel deep learning model to address the challenges posed by the distribution gap between photoplethysmography and blood oxygen saturation in OSAHS detection modeling, while efficiently capturing local and global features. Experimental results have demonstrated that smart rings detected OSAHS in good agreement with PSG, with a correlation coefficient of r =0.93. Our model also outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

With increasing demand for integrating multiple bio-signals into a single chip, it is imperative to address multiple design challenges for efficient multi-modal biosensor acquisition [1]. The bio-signals include bio-potential signals (ExG), photo-plethysmography signals (PPG), and bio-impedance signals (BioZ) that are all unique in their electric properties (voltage, current, and resistance), have a large dynamic range ($4 \times$ order magnitudes in frequency and amplitude), and have a tremendous amount of variation among channels (middle of the Figure 1). abstract_zh: 受人脑的启发，尖峰神经元网络有望实现节能和低延迟的神经形态计算。然而，由于局限性，即使是最先进的硅神经元在面积和功耗方面也比生物神经元差几个数量级。此外，与生物突触相比，典型 CMOS 工艺中的有限布线是实现完全并行高通量突触连接的另一个挑战。本文提出了一种利用资源共享技术来解决这两个挑战的 SNN 电路。首先，提出了一种具有背景校准技术的比较器共享神经元电路，以缩小单个神经元的尺寸而不降低性能。 ...
abstract_en: Inspired by the human brain, spiking neuron networks are promising to realize energy-efficient and low-latency neuromorphic computing. However, even state-of-the-art silicon neurons are orders of magnitude worse than biological neurons in terms of area and power consumption due to the limitations. Moreover, limited routing in typical CMOS processes is another challenge for realizing the fully-parallel high-throughput synapse connections compared to biological synapses. This paper presents an SNN circuit that utilizes resource-sharing techniques to address the two challenges. Firstly, a comparator sharing neuron circuit with a background calibration technique is proposed to shrink the size of a single neuron without performance degradation. Secondly, a time-modulated axon-sharing synapse system is proposed to realize a fully-parallel connection with limited hardware overhead. To validate the proposed approaches, a CMOS neuron array is designed and fabricated under a 55-nm process. It consists of 48 LIF neurons with 3125 neurons/mm${^{_{2}}}$area density, power consumption of 5.3 pJ/spike, and equivalent 2304 fully parallel synapses providing a unit throughput of 5500 events/s/neuron. It proves the proposed approaches are promising to realize a high-throughput high-efficiency SNN with CMOS technology.

title_zh: 基于 CIFF 的两通道时间交错连续时间三阶 Delta-Sigma 调制器
title_en: A Two-Channel Time-Interleaved Continuous-Time Third-Order CIFF-Based Delta-Sigma Modulator
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I Regular Papers
authors: Yue Hu；Yuekai Liu；Xinyu Qin；Yan Liu；Mingqiang Guo；Sai‐Weng Sin；Guoxing Wang；Yong Lian；Liang Qi

abstract_zh: 这项工作介绍了一种双通道时间交错 (TI) 连续时间 (CT) 三阶 Δ-Σ 调制器 (DSM)。它根据外推原理，使用一个完整通道的信息来预测另一通道。请注意，环路滤波器选择分布式前馈级联积分器（CIFF）拓扑的原因如下：1）它可以尽可能减少所需反馈DAC的数量； 2）允许对TI DSM进行零优化，从而进一步提高性能。此外，我们采用纠错技术来解决源自外推 TI DSM 的无延迟反馈路径问题。我们给出了导数...
abstract_en: This work introduces a two-channel time-interleaved (TI) continuous-time (CT) 3rd-order delta-sigma modulator (DSM). It uses the information from one complete channel to predict the other channel based on the extrapolation principle. Note that, Cascaded Integrator of Distributed Feedforward (CIFF) topology is selected for the loop filter for the following reasons: 1) it could reduce the number of required feedback DACs as much as possible; 2) it allows to implement the zero optimization for the TI DSM such that the performance could be further improved. Furthermore, we employ the technique of error correction to address the issue regarding the delay-free feedback path, which originates from the extrapolating TI DSM. We present the derivations of the target TI CT DSM starting from a single-channel discrete-time (DT) DSM, while the compensation for excess loop delay (ELD) is considered. Fabricated in 65nm CMOS process, this modulator achieves an equivalent output sampling rate of 800MS/s, while the analog channel operates at 400MHz. It exhibits a signal-to-noise and distortion ratio (SNDR) /spurious-free dynamic range (SFDR)/dynamic range (DR) of 75.5dB/89.7dB/79dB over a 10MHz bandwidth. The total power consumption is 33.73mW from 1.2v/1.8v power supplies. It results in a Schreier Figure of Merit (FoM) of 163.7dB based on DR.

title_en: Analysis and Design of VCO-Based Neural Front-End With Mixed Domain Level-Crossing for Fast Artifact Recovery
venue: IEEE Trans. Circuits Syst. I Regul. Pap.
authors: Guoxing Wang；Yongwei Lou；Liang Qi；Huaiyu Liu；Yang Lin；Yan Liu
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 能够承受神经刺激伪影的并发神经信号仪器对于双向神经接口保证信号完整性至关重要。在这项工作中，首先回顾了不同的前端结构和刺激伪影缓解技术，以对其阶跃响应速度进行基准测试。然后，提出了一种混合域水平交叉方案，以最小化硬件开销实现快速动态响应。在考虑稳定性和噪声的情况下，研究了扩展基于 VCO 的连续时间 $\rm \Delta \Sigma $ 调制器中相位检测器的相位检测范围的好处。然后提出了一种基于移位寄存器的相位计数器来扩展相位检测器的检测范围，从而提高...
abstract_en: Concurrent neural signal instrumentation withstanding neural stimulation artifacts is essential for bi-directional neural interfaces to guarantee signal integrity. In this work, different front-end structures and stimulation artifact mitigation techniques are firstly reviewed to benchmark their step response speed. Then, a mixed domain level-crossing scheme is proposed to achieve fast dynamic response with minimized hardware overhead. The benefit of extending the phase detection range of the phase detectors in VCO-based continuous time$\rm \Delta \Sigma $modulators is investigated with stability and noise consideration. Then a shift-register-based phase counter is proposed to extend the phase detectors’s detection range, thereby increase quantization resolution and stability margin for in-band noise optimization. The proposed VCO-based neural front-end was fabricated in a 180 nm CMOS process. The prototype achieves$6.38~\mu $Vrms input-referred noise over 0.5 Hz-10 kHz bandwidth. With a linear input range of 120 mVpp, it exhibits a SNDR of 71.6 dB and a DR of 77.0 dB, which could be further extended up to 100 dB in the artifact adaption mode. Measurements verify that the proposed neural front-end can recover from rail-to-rail differential mode or common mode artifacts within 10$\mu \text{s}$(minimum$6.25~\mu \text{s}$) while the superposed small signal can be recorded uninterruptedly.

abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于模拟大脑代谢活动的动态光学模型，并建立了控制电压与物质浓度的线性等效模型。在基础体模表面采用液晶薄膜作为压控光强调节器，以环氧树脂为基体材料，纳米碳粉和二氧化钛粉末分别作为吸收和散射掺杂剂，实现了固-固动态光学体模。动态模型可以模拟近红外光谱（NIRS）信号，采样率高达10 Hz，氧合血红蛋白和脱氧血红蛋白浓度在1 μmol/l范围内变化的最大模拟误差分别为7.0%和17.9%，...
abstract_en: This paper presents a dynamic optical phantom for the simulation of metabolic activities in the brain, and a linear equivalent model is built for control voltage versus substance concentration. A solid-solid dynamic optical phantom is realized by using liquid crystal film as a voltage-controlled light intensity regulator on the surface of basic phantom, which uses epoxy resin as matrix material and nanometer carbon powder and titanium dioxide powder as absorption and scattering dopants, respectively. The dynamic phantom could mimic near-infrared spectrum (NIRS) signals with sampling rate up to 10 Hz, and the maximum simulation errors for oxy-hemoglobin and deoxy-hemoglobin concentrations varying in the range of 1 μmol/l are 7.0% and 17.9%, respectively. Compared with similar solid biomimetic phantoms, the adjustable mimic substance concentration range is extended by an order of magnitude, which meets the simulation requirements of most brain NIRS signals.
